label: Herder–Schlözer controversy contests the warrant for universal measure, compression and graphical historical arrangement
subject: agent.johann-gottfried-herder
agent.august-ludwig-schlozer
object: Universalgeschichte as strict historical science, Plan, system and table

sources.citation: Johann Gottfried Herder, review of Schlözer, Frankfurter gelehrte Anzeigen 60 (28 July 1772), pp. 473-478; Heidelberg digitization DOI 10.11588/diglit.27329
Herder/Schlözer, Beurteilung ... mit Anmerkungen über die Kunst, Universalhistorien zu beurteilen, Vorstellung part II (1773)
Modern reconstruction quoting Herder on Fakta, strenge Wissenschaft, Richtigkeit/Bestimmtheit and Voltaire
Modern scholarship reproducing Herder's questions Wo ist Maaß? Wo sind Data zum Maaße in so verschiednen Zeiten und Völkern?

observations.value: The objection reaches earlier than tabular form: it questions the common measure, developmental axis and commensuration by which heterogeneous times and peoples can be placed into one universal Plan.

Table/synopsis is therefore a downstream operator whose adequacy depends on prior classification, selection and commensuration. Colour is a still later operator and must not inherit the table's warrant automatically.

claim_limit: Directly inspect Herder's 1772 pp.473-478 before using exact phrases as primary quotations. Do not reduce Herder's critique to anti-visuality or anti-table sentiment.

label: Method sequence: table and colour are distinct historical operators

observations.value: source/report -> criticism -> Factum -> measure/category/selection -> Zusammenstellung/Plan -> table/graphical disposition -> colour/illumination -> inspection/association/memory
Chromatic clarity can amplify the perceptual certainty of a classification or relation whose historical commensuration was already weakly warranted before colour was applied.

claim_limit: This operator sequence is an analytical reconstruction, not an actor's single explicit pipeline. Each edge requires independent source control.

label: Herder–Schlözer table/image dispute and Schlözer's graphical pedagogy are prior art

observations.value: Existing scholarship already treats Herder's objections to tables/synopsis/system, Schlözer's mosaic/tableau vocabulary, the 1773 painted chronological-table passage, the 1775 Illumination der Tabelle proposal and the pedagogical function of historical images.

sources.citation: Das Bild als historische Quelle?, discussion of Schlözer's historical-image pedagogy, p. 327 quotation and 1775 illumination note
Aesthetic Temporalities Today, discussion of Schlözer's tables/tableau synchrony and Herder's counter-model of historical Bild/continuum

claim_limit: Do not claim novelty for discovering the table/image controversy, the painted-table passage, the illumination proposal or graphical cognition as such. The project opening is the governance and authorization of successive operators, especially chromatic transformation across domains.

label: Herder–Schlözer and Gatterer–Schlözer disputes are textually distinct but institutionally entangled

observations.value: Biographical and Göttingen historiography place Herder's 1772 attack in a field of existing academic tensions involving Schlözer, Heyne, Gatterer and competing historical programmes; older scholarship specifically suspects Heyne's encouragement of Herder.
Institutional entanglement does not prove that Herder's representation critique and the Species Facti priority allegations make the same argument or concern the same media practices.

sources.citation: Allgemeine Deutsche Biographie / Deutsche Biographie entry on August Ludwig von Schlözer
Modern Göttingen historiography on competition among Gatterer, Schlözer and their institutional environment

claim_limit: Treat Heyne's role as historiographical context, not a proven causal instruction, until correspondence or contemporary documentation is directly controlled.

label: Two textual controversies inside one entangled method field
notes: Revised model: Herder–Schlözer directly contests historical adequacy, commensuration, Plan/system/table and graphical pedagogy; Gatterer–Schlözer directly contests teaching competition, Plan, priority and ownership of Universalgeschichte method. They are institutionally entangled but must remain textually separate. The high-value test is whether graphical/tabular operations become priority-bearing methodological property in Species Facti/Antwort.
reopen_rule: Directly control Herder 1772 and Schlözer 1773 p.327; separately read Schlözer Species Facti and Gatterer Antwort for Plan/Methode/Tafel/Tabelle/Gemälde/Übersicht/Darstellung/Synchronismus. Promote a cross-controversy link only where the sources themselves attach media/ordering operations to method ownership or priority.
